label: ports-cond-n1
_why: PORT-SUBSIDY APPROACH 2 (user-directed, after approach 1 FAILED in 20260816_102931): mandate early-tier ports, retired once enough higher-tier ports exist. wants_to_have proved a fair-weather stance - GBR subsidised 1838-42 (access clean at 1840), dropped it in the treasury squeeze, never re-engaged despite recovery (1846/1852: 535k treasury, zero subsidy), famine back at 0.50-0.59 by 1850. This arm: building_subsidies puts port/port_steam/port_industrial at MUST_HAVE (modern/motor nice_to_have; ALL railways + power nice_to_have by explicit instruction - no railway mandate even early); NEW subsidy_conditional emits each of the 7 admin strategies as a MUTUALLY-EXCLUSIVE PAIR - base carries the mandate with possible = NOT(retire), a _pmr_mature variant retires the early keys to nice_to_have with possible = retire, where retire = any_scope_building{ OR modern/motor, count >= 2 } (verified vanilla constructs; count-based approximation of 'enough in share' - script-value comparison syntax in possible blocks is unverified and was not risked). DOUBLES AS THE STRATEGY RE-PICK PROBE: saves persist each country's active ai_strategy set, so the melts show whether countries actually switch to the mature variant when the trigger flips - the load-bearing unknown for all conditional-subsidy design. DECISION RULE: SOLVED if no overseas state of the six tags sits below 0.9 access for 2+ consecutive dumps in 1840-1890; then per user instruction CONTINUE FROM THE LATEST SAVE to 1936 to read whether the mandate retires (subsidy bill falling as _pmr_mature takes over) instead of draining. FAILED if the famine reappears anyway (mandate not honoured or variants broken - check error.log for possible-block script errors first).
_arms: ports_cond = {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.ports_cond.json} - NOT committed (gitignored). Regenerate: the vancost_nosub recipe (flat 1.0x vanilla-anchor building_cost) with building_subsidies = trade_center:vanilla + port/port_steam/port_industrial:must_have + port_modern/port_motor:nice_to_have + railways x4:nice_to_have + power x3:nice_to_have, plus subsidy_conditional { retire_overrides: early three -> nice_to_have, retire_trigger: any_scope_building = { OR = { is_building_type = building_port_modern is_building_type = building_port_motor } count >= 2 } }. Then cp config/tech_tree_options.json config/tech_tree_options.ports_cond.json. Emission machinery: build.ps1's subsidy_conditional block (2026-08-16).
_comparison: 20260816_102931_ports-w2h-n1 (approach 1, failed) and vancost-nosub-n2 (no mandate, the famine baseline) - same 1.0x cost book throughout.
_cost: 1 run x 64 in-game years, ~60-75 min wall; continued to 1936 from the latest save if solved (~55 min more).
